# Brandora

> Brandora generates a complete brand identity from one short brief. A single
> run produces business name ideas, two logo concepts, a colour palette, font
> pairings, a brand story and voice, a multi-page published website, and a
> social media kit — decided together, so they agree with each other.

Brandora is a web application. A brief of eight questions covers the business,
industry, market, audience, style and language; one queued run then generates
naming, identity, logos, site and social in sequence. Anything generated can be
regenerated with a note on what to change, and every earlier version is kept.

Arabic is an input language, not a translation layer: a brief written in Arabic
is reasoned about in Arabic from the start, and produces Arabic naming, copy and
type choices rather than a translated English result.

Usage is metered in credits. What a plan grants, what each part of a run costs,
and what is included at each tier are listed on the pricing page — this file
deliberately quotes no figures, so it cannot contradict the page that bills.

## Pages

- [Home](https://brandora.enigmitic.com/en): what a run produces, how the brief works, and the Arabic case
- [Pricing](https://brandora.enigmitic.com/en/pricing): plans, credit packs, a plan comparison, and the pricing FAQ
- [Privacy](https://brandora.enigmitic.com/en/privacy): what is collected and what is done with it
- [Terms](https://brandora.enigmitic.com/en/terms): terms of service, including rights to generated work

## Notes

- Customer sites published by Brandora are served on their own subdomains and
  attached domains. They are the customer's pages, not Brandora's, and nothing
  in this file describes them.
- Everything above is a fact stated somewhere in the interface. There are no
  customer counts, ratings or usage figures here because there are none to
  state.
